I'm just gonna say this non-political bit about raising the Little Miami River water level ... Abuse of power aside, there are a lot of people not affiliated with Vance very happy today. It is a canoeing river. I've been on that river more than a thousand times. I was raised on that river Between Morrow, Foster, Loveland and Branch Hill, Ohio. I got Baptized in that River. I had a cousin die in that river. We rode our bikes to that river every day. I made love under the moonlight on the banks of that river more than once. I was hit by a car River Road in Loveland Ohio and knocked unconscious onto the banks of that river. There's probably remnants of a 40 year old trotline still lingering around somewhere I forgot to pull in. All this before I even turned 20. Abuse of power aside, there are some happy people this week. . FYI, I am in no way condoning his abuse of power.
